## Plan: Interactive platform picker on the hero's rotating `.platform` pill

**What & why:** The hero's rotating `.platform` pill (built in [VPHomeHero.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue#L59-L179), styled in [pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css#L423-L520)) becomes interactive: hover/focus/active pauses the roller, click opens a categorized dropdown (Formats/Renderers/Bundlers/Platforms/Design) with icons + brand colors — modeled on the package-manager picker in [CommandCycleRow.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CommandCycleRow.vue#L164-L189), not the language picker's native `<select>`. Picking an item pauses until the whole control is blurred, then cycling resumes forward from that item.

**Steps**
1. **Data model** — extract the 31-item `PLATFORMS` const into a new `platform-options.ts`, add `category` (`formats`/`renderers`/`bundlers`/`platforms`/`design`) and a single dark-hero-safe `color` per item (pulled from the installed `simple-icons` package's `hex` field, not guessed), plus one new `figma` entry so `design` isn't empty.
2. **Pause wiring** *(depends on 1)* — track hover/focus state on the pill, replace the bare `setInterval` with schedule/clear helpers, extract the swap logic into `goToIndex()` shared by both auto-advance and manual picks.
3. **Dropdown menu** *(depends on 1, 2)* — build a `role="menu"` panel grouped by category (headings reused from existing `sidebar.apiGroups.*` i18n keys — no new translations needed), full keyboard support (Enter/Space/Arrows/Escape), closes immediately on pick but stays paused until true blur.
4. **Styling** *(depends on 3)* — new `.platform-picker__*` rules in pantoken.css modeled on `.gs-command-row__popover`, using the same "always-dark hero" translucent-panel treatment as `.gs-started__mode`.
5. **i18n** — no new strings expected; flag if a screen-reader-only trigger label turns out to be needed.

**Relevant files**
- [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue) — pause/resume + dropdown logic
- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/platform-options.ts` (new) — categorized/colored option data
- [docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css#L423-L520) — new interactive/menu styles

**Verification**
1. Manual homepage check: hover/focus/mousedown pauses; click opens grouped menu; pick snaps + stays paused; blur resumes forward from the picked item.
2. Keyboard-only pass (Tab/Enter/Arrows/Escape) — verify `aria-expanded`/focus never gets lost.
3. `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — roller stays static but dropdown still works.
4. `vp check` across touched files.
5. Contrast check of brand colors against the hero's translucent pill background.

**Decisions**
- Hand-rolled menu (icons+colors), not native `<select>` — per your steer.
- Categories fixed order: formats, renderers, bundlers, platforms, design; adding a `figma` entry so `design` has content.
- Select closes menu but doesn't resume; only true blur resumes, continuing forward from the picked index.

**Further Considerations**
1. Add a small hover/focus-only chevron hinting the pill is clickable? (Recommend yes.)
2. Add a screen-reader-only label like "Choose a platform" since the visible text is just the current cycling word? (Recommend yes — one new i18n key.)

Based on my review of the CLI source code, documentation, and related files, here's the complete picture:

## **Exact CLI Command Syntax**

**Base Command:** `pantoken generate <target>`

**Examples:**
```sh
# iOS tokens with icons, Canvas theme
npx pantoken generate swift --out ./ios/Tokens --theme canvas --icons arrow-left,check-mark

# WordPress block theme
npx pantoken generate wordpress --out ./wp-content/themes/mytheme

# Rust tokens for egui
npx pantoken generate rust --out ./src/tokens.rs --format egui
```

**Flags:**
- `--out <dir>` — output directory (default: `./pantoken-out`)
- `--theme <name>` — `rebrand` (default), `canvas`, or `canvasHighContrast`
- `--class <Name>` — generated class/package name (default: `PanTokens`)
- `--icons <a,b,c>` — comma-separated icon names to emit (for supporting targets)
- `--format <fmt>` — output format for multi-format targets (`swatches`: `ase`/`gpl`/`sketch`/`svg`; `rust`: `egui`/`iced`)

**Other subcommands:**
- `pantoken create <platform>` — scaffold a starter project
- `pantoken add <item>` — add components from the pantoken registry

---

## **Platform Name Mapping Table**

| Display Name | CLI Target | NPM Package | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Swift** | ✅ `pantoken generate swift` | — | SPM `Package.swift` + source under `Sources/<Name>/` |
| **Android** | ✅ `pantoken generate android` | — | XML resource files |
| **Compose** | ✅ `pantoken generate compose` | — | Jetpack Compose Kotlin |
| **Flutter** | ✅ `pantoken generate flutter` | — | Flutter Dart |
| **WordPress** | ✅ `pantoken generate wordpress` | — | Block-theme `theme.json` |
| **Drupal** | ✅ `pantoken generate drupal` | — | Drupal theme assets |
| **Hugo** | ✅ `pantoken generate hugo` | — | Hugo site data |
| **Jekyll** | ✅ `pantoken generate jekyll` | — | Jekyll site data |
| **Rust** | ✅ `pantoken generate rust` | — | `tokens.rs` for egui or iced |
| **Vanilla** | ✅ `pantoken generate vanilla` | — | Vanilla Forums `variables.json` |
| **Swatches** | ✅ `pantoken generate swatches` | — | Color swatches (ASE/GPL/Sketch/SVG) |
| **Icon Font** | ✅ `pantoken generate icon-font` | — | Web font (TTF, WOFF2) + CSS + codepoints |
| **Mintlify** | ✅ `pantoken generate mintlify` | — | Mintlify `docs.json` theme |
| **Pendo** | ✅ `pantoken generate pendo` | — | Instructure-styled `global.css` |
| **Web** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/css` | CSS with `@property`, `light-dark()` |
| **React** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/react` | Hooks, `<Icon>`, token provider |
| **Vue** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/vue` | Web components + Vue integration |
| **Angular** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/angular` | Web components + Angular integration |
| **Svelte** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/svelte` | Web components + Svelte integration |
| **Web Components** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/web-components` | `<instui-icon>`, styled primitives |
| **Astro** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/astro` | Token setup for Astro |
| **Vite** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/vite` | Vite plugin with virtual modules |
| **Webpack** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/webpack` | webpack plugin |
| **Next.js** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/next` | `withPantoken` for transpilePackages |
| **Tailwind** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/tailwind` | Tailwind preset |
| **PostCSS** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/postcss` | `@pantoken` at-rule |
| **Sass** | ❌ No CLI | `@pantoken/scss` | SCSS variables |

## **Key Distinction**

## Scope (expanded from original "just add a dropdown" ask)
Three things, all interdependent:
1. The hero's rotating `.platform` pill pauses on hover/focus/active.
2. Clicking it opens a categorized (Formats/Renderers/Bundlers/Platforms/Design) dropdown, styled
   like the package-manager popover in CommandCycleRow.vue (icons + brand colors, not a native
   `<select>`). Picking an item jumps the pill there and keeps it paused until blur.
3. **New:** the mock terminal in GetStartedTabs.vue is synced to the pill: each platform gets a real
   `pantoken` CLI command (or an npm-install command, for platforms with no CLI verb), and the
   terminal's type/backspace animation is driven by the *same* cycle as the pill's slide animation:
   platform slides in → command types → holds → backspace-deletes → platform slides out → next
   platform slides in. The `<pm>` prefix (vpx/pnpm/deno/bun/npm/yarn) keeps advancing every cycle,
   independently wrapping at its own length, in lockstep with the platform index (both odometer
   counters tick once per full cycle). Hovering/focusing *either* the pill or the terminal pauses
   both.

## Verified CLI command mapping (read from actual source, not guessed)
Source: [packages/cli/README.md](packages/cli/README.md), [packages/cli/src/index.ts](packages/cli/src/index.ts#L48-L64)
(`SUPPORTED` set), [packages/scaffold/src/index.ts](packages/scaffold/src/index.ts#L81-L83) (`SCAFFOLD_PLATFORMS`
derived from `packages/scaffold/templates/*` directory names), [packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts](packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts#L117-L124)
(`PLATFORM_DISPLAY_LABELS`, incl. `components: "HTML"` / alias `html`→`components`).

**`pantoken generate <target>`** (10 of our 32): swift, android, compose, flutter, wordpress,
drupal, rust, jekyll, hugo, mintlify.

**`pantoken create <target>`** (7 of our 32): react, vue, angular, svelte, web-components, next,
and **web → `create components`** (arg differs from display name; `html` is an accepted alias).

**Install-only, no pantoken CLI verb** (15 of our 32) — shown as `<pm-install-verb> @pantoken/<pkg>`:
astro, vite, webpack, tailwind, postcss, **sass → package is `@pantoken/scss`** (arg differs),
stylus, storybook, bootstrap, docusaurus, shadcn, mui, foundation, tinymce, figma.

(new, for the install-only third):
| pm id | dlx launcher (existing) | install-verb launcher (new) |
|---|---|---|
| vpx | `vpx ` | `vp add ` *(confirmed via viteplus.dev/guide — "Manage Dependencies" section)* |
| pnpm | `pnpm dlx ` | `pnpm add ` |
| deno | `deno run npm:` | `deno add npm:` |
| bun | `bunx ` | `bun add ` |
| npm | `npx ` | `npm install ` |
| yarn | `yarn dlx ` | `yarn add ` |

Full command text per platform = `<pm launcher variant> + "pantoken " + verb + " " + arg` for
generate/create, or `<pm install-verb launcher> + "@pantoken/" + arg` for install-only.

## Data model
New `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/platform-options.ts`:
```
interface PlatformCommand {
  verb: "generate" | "create" | "install";
  arg: string; // CLI target name, or npm scope suffix for install
}
interface PlatformOption {
  name: string; label: string; icon: string;
  category: "formats" | "renderers" | "bundlers" | "platforms" | "design";
  color: string; // single hex, dark-hero-safe (see prior research: hero bg is always dark)
  command: PlatformCommand;
}
PLATFORM_OPTIONS: PlatformOption[]  // existing 31 + new `figma` entry (design category)
PLATFORM_CATEGORY_ORDER = ["formats","renderers","bundlers","platforms","design"]
```
Category assignments (unchanged from prior research): formats = web, sass, stylus · renderers =
react, vue, angular, svelte, astro, web-components, mui, bootstrap, shadcn, docusaurus, mintlify,
storybook, tinymce, foundation · bundlers = vite, webpack, tailwind, postcss, next · platforms =
swift, android, compose, flutter, rust, drupal, hugo, jekyll, wordpress · design = figma (new).

Brand `color` per item: pull real hex from the installed `simple-icons` package's `hex` field via a
throwaway script (don't hardcode from memory — see user memory `dependency-versions.md`); adjust any
that read poorly on the dark hero bg.

Extend `pmOptions` in GetStartedTabs.vue (or move it alongside `platform-options.ts`) with an
`installLauncher` field per entry per the table above.

Currently two independent systems exist:

  (450ms transition), no Vue reactivity.

  `phase` state machine (`idle → typing → paused → deleting → idle`) driving char-by-char

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DefaultTheme } from "vitepress/theme";
import { useData } from "vitepress";
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";
import VPButton from "vitepress/dist/client/theme-default/components/VPButton.vue";
import VPImage from "vitepress/dist/client/theme-default/components/VPImage.vue";
import GetStartedTabs from "./GetStartedTabs.vue";
import { PLATFORM_CATEGORY_ORDER, PLATFORM_OPTIONS, type PlatformOption } from "./platform-options.ts";
import { usePlatformTerminalCycle } from "./usePlatformTerminalCycle.ts";

interface HeroAction {
  theme?: "brand" | "alt";
  text: string;
  link: string;
  target?: string;
  rel?: string;
}

type DocsThemeWithPlatformPicker = {
  platformPicker?: { label?: string };
  sidebar?: { apiGroups?: Partial<Record<PlatformOption["category"], string>> };
};

const { frontmatter: fm, theme } = useData<DocsThemeWithPlatformPicker>();

const pickerLabel = () => theme.value.platformPicker?.label ?? "Choose a platform";
const categoryLabel = (category: PlatformOption["category"]) =>
  theme.value.sidebar?.apiGroups?.[category] ?? category;

const heroTextRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
let syncViewportWidth: (() => void) | undefined;
let menuOpen = false;
let hovering = false;
let focused = false;

const reducedMotion = ref(false);

// Shared with GetStartedTabs.vue's mock terminal (a child of this component) — the pill's slide
// and the terminal's type/backspace are driven by the same phase machine so they stay in lockstep.
const platformCycle = usePlatformTerminalCycle({ reducedMotion });

onMounted(() => {
  reducedMotion.value = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  const platformEl = heroTextRef.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".platform");
  if (!platformEl) return;

  const initialIndex = PLATFORM_OPTIONS.findIndex((platform) =>
    platformEl.classList.contains(platform.name),
  );
  if (initialIndex >= 0) platformCycle.platformIndex.value = initialIndex;

  const iconViewport = document.createElement("span");
  iconViewport.className = "platform-glyph-viewport";

  let currentIcon = document.createElement("span");
  currentIcon.className = "platform-glyph";
  currentIcon.style.setProperty(
    "--pantoken-glyph",
    `var(--instui-icon-${platformCycle.activePlatform.value.icon})`,
  );
  iconViewport.append(currentIcon);

  const viewport = document.createElement("span");
  viewport.className = "platform-viewport";

  let currentLabel = document.createElement("span");
  currentLabel.className = "platform-label";
  currentLabel.textContent = platformEl.textContent;
  viewport.append(currentLabel);

  const srLabel = document.createElement("span");
  srLabel.className = "instui-screen-reader-content";
  srLabel.textContent = `${pickerLabel()}: `;

  const chevron = document.createElement("span");
  chevron.className = "platform-picker__chevron";
  chevron.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

  platformEl.textContent = "";
  platformEl.append(srLabel, iconViewport, viewport, chevron);
  viewport.style.width = `${currentLabel.offsetWidth}px`;

  platformEl.setAttribute("role", "button");
  platformEl.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
  platformEl.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "true");
  platformEl.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

  // .platform's flex centering positions the viewport geometrically, not by text baseline, so
